e6.meaning: Deferred to administrative verification; it is not treated as YES and is not part of the title/abstract aggregate.

outcome_rules.EXCLUDED: At least one of E1-E5 is a defensible scientific NO.
outcome_rules.UNCERTAIN: There is no E1-E5 NO and at least one E1-E5 response is UNCERTAIN, or E7 is NO or UNCERTAIN.
outcome_rules.INCLUDE: E1-E5 and E7 are all YES; retain for further assessment, not final inclusion.

routing_priority: EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION when the supplied title/abstract evidence is mismatched or otherwise conflicted.
TARGETED_SECOND_REVIEW when responses are incomplete or invalid.
NONE for EXCLUDED unless evidence reconciliation takes precedence.
METADATA_RECOVERY for a non-excluded record with no abstract.
TARGETED_SECOND_REVIEW when prospectively requested after the earlier routes do not apply.
FULL_TEXT_ASSESSMENT for remaining complete INCLUDE or UNCERTAIN records.
title_only_rule: Explicit title evidence may support an individual criterion; a promising title does not establish all criteria.

historical_compatibility.schema_1_x: Detected and validated under the frozen E1-E7/ELIGIBLE contract; no reinterpretation as version 2.0.0.
historical_compatibility.schema_2_0_0: Detected by the explicit Return schema version instruction and recomputed from E1-E5/E7.
